description.value:
♒ Aquarius rises Exalted today. This is the one day in two hundred and sixty. For the whole day your Techniques heighten as though you were 8 levels higher, and you have your Zenith Boon.

As the Ascendant Boon, plus Aurora Execution once per minute ◆◆◆: 60-foot line, @Damage[16d6[cold]] damage, basic Fortitude; a critical failure leaves the creature frozen solid (petrified, shatterable). Incapacitation.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Ascendant Constellation]. A Zenith is scheduled by the GM, never rolled.

rules.text: Cold damage you deal forces a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or slowed 1, cumulative; at slowed 4 the creature is petrified in ice. Your cold ignores cold resistance and treats cold immunity as resistance 10.
rules.title: Freezing Coffin
